canonical_name: Fearn Airfield and Surrounds data centre opportunity
summary: Marketed inward-investment prospect, not a project: Invest Highland lists 315 hectares at the former RAF Fearn airfield and surrounding land in Easter Ross, owned by a local landowner, for renewable energy, data centre and commercial development. No developer or operator has been identified and no planning application for a data centre exists.
maturity_explanation: Agency marketing listing only: land allocated/promoted for renewable energy, data centre and commercial uses. No named developer, no planning record found for a data centre at Fearn on the Highland register or PlanIt.
unknowns: Identity of the 'local landowner' marketing the 315 ha
